shared_rules.phase: current P1/P2 plus projected P1 sign transition
shared_rules.turning_tendency: P1/P2 opposition, projected P1 crossing, projected P2 reversal
shared_rules.confidence_thresholds: development-only Q50/Q95 of condition, max-real eigenvalue, and per-field perturbation amplification
shared_rules.directional_colors: GREEN for confident upward acceleration/turning-up; RED for confident downward acceleration/turning-down; AMBER otherwise

selection_rule: Select debounce only if direct reversals or total color changes decrease at least 20% and both maximum/minimum precursor recall decrease no more than 0.02 absolute; otherwise select raw phase rules.
